content.text:
The Valentine's run finished on schedule. I started it at 00:00 Wed Feb 10 Auckland time and it ended at 00:00 Mon Feb 15, so it covered all five days. Everything is within the $350 budget.

**Results** (Feb 10–14 Auckland time, all placements on X)

| | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Post 2151999341984599416 ("Small things deserve a page") | $126.45 | 141,229 | 90 |
| Post 2152180535917362170 ("Give someone a reason") | $125.79 | 143,765 | 91 |
| Post 2152542923785236383 ("Worldwide except…") | $89.88 | 131,587 | 51 |
| **Total** | **$342.12** | **416,581** | **232** |

- **Installs:** I can't report any. The site has no X pixel, so these figures stop at link clicks and installs are not counted here. Please check App Store Connect or your own analytics for them.
- **Setup:** One campaign (oqyfj) with three ad groups, one per post, optimized for link clicks. Each ad group was limited to iPhone users, English speakers, and the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Ireland.
- **Post 2152361729849701644:** I didn't promote it. It has no offer, no deadline and no mention of iPhone, so it wouldn't encourage installs.
- **Mid-flight change:** On Feb 13 the "Worldwide except…" post was getting fewer clicks ($1.76 per click, versus about $1.38–1.40 for the other two), so I paused it. I moved its budget to the other two. It had spent $89.88 by then.
- **Unlock deadline:** All three promoted posts say "Feb 14, 2027", so the deadline stayed accurate through the run.
- **Languages:** I only ran English. The four approved posts are all English, and you asked me not to write new ones. The localized versions you mentioned weren't available to me. If you send those post IDs, a multi-language run is straightforward to add.
- **Budget:** $7.88 of the $350 went unspent.
